rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.02 signals near-complete price compression, making it impossible to define a meaningful risk/reward structure — any stop tight enough to be rational would be triggered by noise, and any stop wide enough to survive would offer no viable profit target. Price is consolidating in a 2-cent band at today's lows with no impulsive candle suggesting directional commitment in either direction. The setup lacks sufficient mechanical edge to justify capital deployment.
